opening.argument: The presentation is expressly structured as medical instruction on COVID-19 pneumonia: it introduces CO-RADS classification and CT severity scoring, then explains each system through classification and per-lobe scoring tables. The visible material covers CO-RADS levels, corresponding CT findings, lung-involvement ranges, and related CT changes over time. This is a focused educational and operational demonstration of how findings are classified and scored. References to a hospital, doctor, and external website function as attribution or informational resources; there is no request for payment, credentials, investment, or other financial participation. The observable purpose and presentation therefore support an educational medical explanation rather than a financial solicitation.
